cfl.read: the infobox's first capacity, 54,500, which Wikidata's capacity (P1083) also gives; the article's stand for football of the CFL's club

soccer.read: the infobox's capacity for the 2026 world cup of soccer, 52,497, 2,003 fewer than its first

tiers.read: the infobox's lower bowl of 27,695 seats, and the article's lower and upper bowls (the club that plays soccer there sold only the lower bowl)

roof.read: the article: a retractable roof supported by cables, the largest of its kind, its opening 100 by 85 metres (the size of the field), the fabric retracting into a pod in the middle of the opening above the suspended video board
